description.value: The NAR Railway Station Museum preserves the heritage of the Northern Alberta Railways in the Dawson Creek area of northeastern British Columbia. It is located within NAR Park and commemorates the railway history that was pivotal to the region's development. A touring cyclist passing through Dawson Creek would find it a notable heritage stop, though operational details could not be verified.
